caption:
The Bible feels scattered. You collect verses like life tips — but the pieces never add up, because you're missing the one thread that ties them. (Galatians 3:16 devotional)

God aimed every promise at a single Person — "not 'seeds' but 'seed,' who is Christ" — so the whole Book is one story, not a toolbox of rules. Jesus said the same: the Scriptures bear witness about Him, and Moses wrote of Him. Read through the frame of Christ and every scattered thread converges on Him.
